records.label: spacr.qt.job_runner.shutdown_all#1
records.source: Call before Qt starts destroying widgets. Cancellation is requested for all runners before any wait, then they share one ``timeout_ms`` wait deadline. This bounds thread waiting, not the total application exit time. Threads that outlast the budget are parked by :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.drain_thread`, not terminated. Failed shutdown calls are logged, excluded from the return count, and do not stop the remaining runners from being processed.
records.context: Call before Qt starts destroying widgets. Cancellation is requested for all runners before any wait, then they share one ``timeout_ms`` wait deadline. This bounds independent execution path waiting, not the total application exit time. Independent execution paths that outlast the budget are parked by :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.drain_thread`, not terminated. Failed shutdown calls are logged, excluded from the return count, and do not stop the remaining runners from being processed.
records.translation: Anropa innan Qt börjar förstöra widgetar. Avbrott begärs för alla körare före någon väntan, och därefter delar de en väntetidsgräns på ``timeout_ms``. Detta begränsar väntan på trådar, inte programmets totala avslutningstid. Trådar som överskrider tidsbudgeten parkeras av :func:`spacr.qt.bridge.drain_thread` och tvångsavslutas inte. Misslyckade avstängningsanrop loggas, räknas inte i returvärdet och hindrar inte att återstående körare behandlas.
